feedback.problem: What is the quotient of $3{x}^{3}-8$ divided by ${x}^{2}-1?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that the dividend is missing the ${x}^{2}$ and $x$ terms. So, we first rewrite it by including the missing terms with zero coefficients, as follows:

$$
3{x}^{3}-8=3{x}^{3}+0{x}^{2}+0x-8
$$

Now, using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,3x \\  & {x}^{2}-1\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,3{x}^{3}+0{x}^{2}+0x-8\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{3{x}^{3}+0{x}^{2}-3x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,3x-8\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $3x,$ and

- the remainder is $3x-8.$
